serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-prompt-injection-scanner
serverInfo.description: MCP server that scans documents, scraped pages, and RAG content for indirect prompt injection payloads — instruction-override phrases, spoofed chat-template roles, hidden/invisible text, content addressing the AI directly, and data-exfiltration attempts

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan a text string — a RAG chunk, a scraped web page, a document, a tool result — for indirect prompt injection payloads (instruction-override phrases, spoofed chat-template roles, hidden/invisible text, content addressing 'the AI' directly, data-exfiltration attempts) before it reaches a model's context.

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. source URL or filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file (a knowledge-base document, an HTML page, extracted text) for indirect prompt injection payloads

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory — e.g. a RAG knowledge base or a corpus of scraped pages — for indirect prompt injection payloads. Automatically skips node_modules, .git, dist, and binary files.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List all indirect prompt injection patterns that the scanner can detect, grouped by category
